data.gender_notes: Vishnunandan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism, and nandan meaning 'gift'. The name Vishnunandan carries the meaning “Gift of Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vishnunandan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine protection and blessings.
data.etymology: Vishnunandan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishnunandan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Vishnunandan was a title given to several notable figures in Hinduism history. One such figure was the 16th century monarch and saint, Rama Chandra Raghunatha Raya, who ruled over the Vijayanagara Empire. He was known for his devotion to Lord Vishnu and assumed the title Vishnunandan during his reign.

Another Vishnunandan was Swami Vishnudas, a 19th century Hindu saint and philosopher from Bengal, India. He is known for his contributions to the philosophy of Advaita Vedanta and the Bhagavad Gita. Vishnudas adopted the title Vishnunandan as a mark of his deep devotion to Lord Vishnu.
